stem.text: A boy throws a stone with a horizontal velocity of $10\,\text{m s}^{-1}$ from the top of a building. The height of the building is $8.0\,\text{m}$. The stone travels along a curved path until it hits the horizontal ground, as shown.

stem.alt: Diagram of a building with a stone's curved path from the top edge of the building to the horizontal ground. Printed labels: building, 10 m s-1, 8.0 m, ground.

stem.text: How long does it take the stone to reach the ground?
